## What's changed

- Added server-managed upscaling controls under Processing, including Standard, Off, and experimental AI modes.
- Added optional FSRCNNX AI upscaling with automatic compatibility checks and a safe fallback to high-quality standard scaling when AI acceleration is unavailable.
- Preserved the name entered when creating a player pairing PIN instead of allowing the player's generic device name to replace it.
- Expanded Docker, macOS, configuration, and hardware guidance for the new processing options.

Players do not need to be updated for these server-side improvements.
